[ASSISTANT_SAID] Breakfast ideas include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Avocado Toast: Toast whole grain bread, mash an avocado, and spread it on top. Add a sliced egg, salt, and pepper to taste.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Greek Yogurt Parfait: Layer Greek yogurt, fresh berries, and granola in a bowl. Add chia seeds or hemp seeds for extra nutrition.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Smoothie: Blend fruits, Greek yogurt, and milk (or a milk alternative). Add spinach or kale for extra nutrition.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Peanut Butter Banana Toast: Toast whole grain bread, spread with peanut butter, and top with sliced banana.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Breakfast Bowl: Mix cooked quinoa with milk, honey, nuts or seeds, and sliced fruit.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Hard-Boiled Eggs: Boil eggs on the weekend for a quick protein-packed breakfast.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Chia Seed Pudding: Mix chia seeds with milk and let sit overnight. Top with fresh fruit and nuts.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Cottage Cheese and Fruit: Mix cottage cheese with fruit for a high-protein breakfast.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Green Smoothie Bowl: Blend spinach, Greek yogurt, milk, and fruit, then top with granola, nuts, and seeds.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Muffin Tin Frittatas: Whisk eggs, milk, and diced veggies, pour into muffin tins, and bake.
